prompt: What is the stated goal of the trial?
promptZh: 試驗的明確目標是什麼？

options.text: To reduce brushing work without changing the finish
options.zh: 在不改變表面效果的情況下，減少拉絲作業時間
options.whyZh: 信件開頭同時說明縮短作業時間與維持表面效果兩個目標。

options.text: To reduce waiting time at the inspection station
options.zh: 縮短在檢驗站的等待時間

options.text: To establish the capacity of each wash rack
options.whyZh: 清洗批次只是比較條件，不是在測架子容量。

options.text: To replace hand preparation with machine preparation
options.zh: 以機器前處理取代手工前處理
options.whyZh: 前處理方式是比較時要控制的條件。

explanationZh: 信件開頭同時說明縮短作業時間與維持表面效果兩個目標。

vocabulary.note: 這個試驗只計實際打磨，不把排隊或等待算入。

evidence: We want to find out whether a revised brushing recipe reduces hands-on work without changing the finish of our stainless-steel instrument covers.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We want to find out whether a revised brushing recipe reduces hands-on work without changing the finish of our stainless-steel instrument covers.
